latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release focused on rigorous research design and computational method auditing for drug discovery.

- Introduces a multi-phase protocol: request classification, protocol execution, flaw audit, solution matrix, and structured output.
- Automatically triggers for any CADD or computational chemistry workflow, code analysis, or method review related to drug design.
- Includes a mandatory "Fatal Flaw Audit" for high-level requests (dynamic systems, thermodynamic missteps, data sparsity, and SOTA obsolescence).
- Provides tiered solution plans (A/B/C) tied to resource cost and physical precision.
- Standardizes output format and review tone, prioritizing physical and mathematical rigor in all responses.
